name: Order Domain
description: A cleric subclass that adds the Order tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Bonus Proficiencies
grants.description: Gain Heavy Armor proficiency and proficiency in either Intimidation or Persuasion.

grants.name: Voice of Authority
grants.description: When you affect an ally with a spell using a spell slot, that ally can use its Reaction immediately after the spell to make one weapon attack against a target you can see.

grants.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
grants.description: As an Action, present your Holy Symbol. Chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wisdom save; a failure Charms them until the end of your next turn and makes them drop what they are holding.

grants.name: Embodiment of the Law
grants.description: When you cast an Enchantment spell with a one-action casting time, you can make it a Bonus Action. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier per Long Rest.

grants.name: Order's Wrath
grants.description: Once per turn when your Divine Strike damages a creature, mark it until your next turn. The next weapon hit against it by an ally deals an extra 2d8 Psychic damage.
